description: This file contains a utility class 'DatabaseUpgradeTestUtil' designed for testing database upgrade processes in the OpenMRS project. It manages temporary H2 database instances, applies dataset states, executes Liquibase migrations, and provides methods for database querying and property insertion.

classes.name: DatabaseUpgradeTestUtil
classes.description: A utility class for managing database upgrade testing, including setup of temporary H2 databases, dataset loading, executing Liquibase migrations, and querying the database.

methods.name: DatabaseUpgradeTestUtil
methods.description: Constructor initializing an in-memory H2 database based on a resource initial database path, setting up DBUnit and Liquibase connections.

methods.description: Closes database connections and deletes temporary files and directories.

methods.name: executeDataset
methods.description: Loads a dataset from a resource path into the database using DBUnit.
